title: Voltas Window Air Conditioner, 1.5 Ton, 2 Star - 182FS Pearl
description: Meet the Voltas Pearl 1.5 Ton 2 Star Fixed Speed Window Room AC reliable, value‑driven cooling for everyday comfort. Built to handle Indian summers, its High Ambient Cooling maintains steady performance even at 48°C, keeping your room comfortable when heat peaks. The fixed‑speed compressor delivers consistent, dependable cooling, while the 2 Star rating helps balance performance with optimized power use. Upkeep stays simple with the Filter Clean Indicator, prompting timely maintenance so airflow remains strong and fresh. The Anti Dust Filter helps trap dust and fine particles to improve air quality and protect the coil for sustained performance.
